name: Tila de Marcuse
source:
Tila de Marcuse is the First Princess Of the Marcuse Kingdom. She boards Isis in order to assist Serena Kirke on her mission. 

[spoiler]She eventually gets brainwashed by Dario Dalisso, like the rest of the female crew on Isis, and becomes his sex slave.[spoiler]
